intended_object: The condition in Beck's comonadicity theorem that F creates limits (equalizers) of every F-cosplit pair, i.e. of every parallel pair f, g whose image under F has a split equalizer. This is read off from the docstring, which calls it the dual of `Monad.CreatesColimitOfIsSplitPair`, and from its use in the Beck comonadicity section.
explanation:
The class has a single field: for every pair `f g : A ⟶ B` with `[F.IsCosplitPair f g]`, there is `CreatesLimit (parallelPair f g) F`. Here `IsCosplitPair` means that `F.map f` and `F.map g` have a split equalizer. This is exactly the hypothesis of the creation form of Beck's comonadicity theorem. It is also the exact dual of `Monad.CreatesColimitOfIsSplitPair` (Monadicity.lean:334), which has the field `∀ f g [G.IsSplitPair f g], CreatesColimit (parallelPair f g) G`.

The definition is a class carrying data, because `CreatesLimit` is data, and that is the right encoding. The variable block gives C and D the same hom universe `v₁`. This matches the setting of the monadicity and comonadicity files, where an adjunction is present anyway, and it is not a meaningful loss of generality. Apart from the docstring's own pointer to that monad-side dual, Mathlib has no other declaration of this notion.
